Four photos and eight R plots, one by one, and a figure with two subfigures.
Keep this page as it is: the benchmark compares each run with a baseline
measured on it (see tests/README.md, Benchmark).

```{r}
#| include: false

wave <- function(k = 1) {
  x <- seq(0, 4 * pi, length.out = 400)
  plot(
    x,
    sin(k * x),
    type = "l",
    lwd = 2,
    col = hcl.colors(8)[k],
    main = paste("Wave", k),
    xlab = "x",
    ylab = "sin(kx)"
  )
}
```
